scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev -w @open-remote-mcp/server" "npm run dev -w @open-remote-mcp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @open-remote-mcp/web && npm run build -w @open-remote-mcp/server && npm run build -w @open-remote-mcp/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @open-remote-mcp/server && npm run typecheck -w @open-remote-mcp/agent && npm run typecheck -w @open-remote-mcp/web
